format.timing_basis: 176 wpm, Emily's clip 1 raw pace measured with the fast-pace rule; retime to the real clips

why_2_loops: About 24 s: the psychology report says under 30 s = 1 loop, 30-60 s = 2 loops, and Howie (00:25:08) says a 30 s ad has no time for A, B and C. So the wholesaler line is payload inside loop B, not its own loop.

research.source: competitor cut analysis of 44 Meta ads, 2026-09-26

rules: 3 Omni clips of 8 s, one continuous take each; every cut is made in the edit
loop lines on his face; payload on object b-roll or a punch-in; the trust line never cuts away
object b-roll: objects and places only, matched to the words
the voice runs unbroken under every cut
